data.description: The raw data string used to generate QR code, it should be used together with QR code library.

hosted_instructions_url.description: The URL to the hosted PromptPay instructions page, which allows customers to view the PromptPay QR code.

image_url_png.description: The PNG path used to render the QR code, can be used as the source in an HTML img tag

image_url_svg.description: The SVG path used to render the QR code, can be used as the source in an HTML img tag
